worked.problem: On a Cartesian plane A(-4; -1) and B(-1; -5). Find the exact distance AB.
actions: Plot A(-4; -1) and B(-1; -5) on the same axes.
Draw horizontal run Δx=3 and vertical rise Δy=-4.
Use AB²=(Δx)²+(Δy)²=3²+(-4)²=25.
Take the positive root: AB=√25=5 units.
Answer: AB = 5 units. Check by squaring: 5²=9+16.
worked.check: Answer: AB = 5 units. Check by squaring: 5²=9+16.
worked.misconception: Keep the coordinates and axis scales visible; derive each conclusion from exact differences.
